rationale: Feedforward 0.53 (=0.883*target) carries steady-state load so integrator only trims residual; P=0.9 gives ~0.045 correction at band edge (0.05 error) and ~0.27 at 0.3 error for 12-18 s fill without large momentum; I=0.10 with +/-0.25 clamp removes offset from 0.52-0.55 hold uncertainty without windup; 0.8 s exponential filter cuts +/-0.015 noise to ~+/-0.005 while adding <1 s lag vs 1-3 s plant lag and ~12 s drain time constant; conditional freeze on saturation plus output clamp [0,1], 1.0/s slew, and hard safety (yf>0.75 cap 0.25, yf>0.82 force 0) prevent overshoot to 0.85/0.9.
